title: Genetic characterization of the apterous Life Span Enhancer in Drosophila melanogaster
authors: Reinger C; Sickmann M; Bieli D; Fröhlich KE; Schmidt A; Affolter M; Müller M
one_liner_zh: 该文通过遗传学手段鉴定果蝇apterous基因的顺式调控元件apLSE，虽涉及DNA调控元件与蛋白功能，但核心是发育表型与生存机制，无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The selector gene apterous ( ap ) of Drosophila melanogaster is best known for its prominent role in wing formation. ap null flies are viable but have no wings. However, ap null flies are associated with another phenotype whose analysis was largely neglected in the past 40 years: adults die precociously 2-3 days after eclosion. We have recently published a comprehensive analysis on the physiology of this striking phenotype. We showed that Ap protein is essential early in metamorphosis during hindgut remodeling where it is required for rectal papillae formation in the rectal ampulla. Wild-type flies have four rectal papillae that are involved in selective reabsorption of essential ions and metabolites from the primary urine produced by the Malpighian tubules. In ap null flies, rectal papillae formation is aborted prematurely. The corresponding papillar cells remain stuck in the rectal lumen. This leads to complete intestinal blockage and a cascade of pathologies resulting in premature death. In this study, we genetically identify and functionally dissect a novel tissue specific cis- regulatory element that directs Ap expression in the hindgut. This Life Span Enhancer (apLSE) maps to a ∼400 bp DNA fragment that is activated via only two small regulatory modules. Genetic analysis of ap LSE alleles proves that they are essential for papilla formation and thus for adult survival. Our studies solve the 110-year-old enigma about the ap syndrome. They establish the apLSE as a key player linking hindgut morphogenesis and survival. We propose that several aspects of the ap syndrome are a consequence of drastic changes in endocrine homeostasis.
abstract_zh: 果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）的选择器基因apterous（ap）因其在翅膀形成中的显著作用而闻名。ap无效突变体果蝇可存活但无翅膀。然而，ap无效突变体还伴随另一种在过去40年中 largely 被忽视的表型：成虫在羽化后2-3天过早死亡。我们最近发表了对这一显著表型生理学的全面分析。我们表明，Ap蛋白在变态早期后肠重塑过程中至关重要，该过程需要其在直肠壶腹中形成直肠乳头。野生型果蝇有四个直肠乳头，参与从马氏管产生的原尿中选择性重吸收必需离子和代谢物。在ap无效突变体中，直肠乳头形成过早中止，相应的乳头细胞滞留在直肠腔内，导致完全肠道阻塞及一系列病理变化，最终引发过早死亡。在本研究中，我们通过遗传学方法鉴定并功能解析了一个新的组织特异性顺式调控元件，该元件指导后肠中的Ap表达。这个寿命增强子（Life Span Enhancer, apLSE）定位到约400 bp的DNA片段，仅通过两个小型调控模块被激活。对apLSE等位基因的遗传分析证明，它们对乳头形成及成虫存活至关重要。我们的研究解决了关于ap综合征的110年之谜，确立了apLSE作为连接后肠形态发生与存活的关键因子。我们提出，ap综合征的多个方面是内分泌稳态剧烈变化的结果。
